subject: Portal activation — MSA redline + invoice/EDI field mapping for Coupa
content:
From: Julia Park <julia.park@medtrek.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Cc: procure@medtrek.com
Date: 2025-05-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Coupa activation: PO/Invoice schema + MSA checklist

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We are ready to move forward with Coupa activation and need to confirm two things before we hand the vendor portal to our procurement integrator: a) the MSA/order form redline process (we have a few standard clauses we require), and b) the PO/invoice schema fields your portal will accept for automated invoice-acknowledgement and ERP reconciliation.

I've attached our current PO schema (MedTrek_PO_schema_v2.xlsx). Key asks: do you support line-level SKU -> lineUnitPrice, remitTo account mapping, and an invoiceAck flag (we send 997 X12 acknowledgements back to suppliers today)? Also let us know if you need a narrower remitTo format or any vendor identifier we should populate.

Our procurement team would like a legal redline on your MSA + order form and a short checklist we can attach to our Coupa onboarding ticket. Can you loop in legal and ops?

Thanks,
Julia Park
Procurement Manager | MedTrek Pharma
Julia.Park@medtrek.com
Attachment: MedTrek_PO_schema_v2.xlsx (xlsx)

-----Original Message-----

From: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Julia Park <julia.park@medtrek.com>
Date: 2025-05-17T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Coupa activation: PO/Invoice schema + MSA checklist

Folks — forwarding MedTrek's schema and ask. TL;DR: they need (1) legal redline of our MSA/order form to confirm invoice acknowledgement and audit clause language, and (2) ops confirmation of the exact PO/invoice fields to map in their Coupa connector.

Proposed immediate steps:
- Marissa: can you review/produce a redlined MSA + short comment memo by EOD Monday? Key negotiation points: invoice-ack SLA, audit log retention, and order form field definitions.
- Marcus: can your team validate the attached PO schema for the connector and call out any field mismatches (esp remitTo format, invoiceAck boolean, and line-level tax fields)?
- Laura: once legal and infra land, can you prepare the onboarding checklist for Coupa (orderform field mapping, required attachments, SFTP/EDI endpoints)?

I'll coordinate with Julia on timelines.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Sr. Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

-----Original Message-----

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Julia Park <julia.park@medtrek.com>
Date: 2025-05-18T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Coupa activation: PO/Invoice schema + MSA checklist

Naomi / team / Julia — I reviewed the current MSA and produced a redline (attached: Redwood_MSA_v3_redlined.docx). Summary of legal positions and asks below. I kept changes narrow and procurement-friendly where possible.

Summary of requested edits (high level):
- Invoice acknowledgement (new clause): we propose Redwood provide an invoiceAck receipt within 48 hours of processing; we will accept either a Coupa/EDI 997 or an API callback. This is to align SLA expectations between parties.
- Audit/logging clause: MedTrek requested 7 years of transaction audit logs. We propose 3 years standard, with the option to extend based on a paid add-on or specific industry requirement.
- Data residency & restricted data: clarified that Redwood will store metadata (invoice ids, status) in region indicated by account and that customer PII/NPI handling will follow the Data Processing Addendum attached.
- Order form field requirements: we added a table of required fields to the order form (PO number, PO line id, sku, lineQuantity, lineUnitPrice, taxAmount, remitToId, vendorExternalId). We propose the Order Form include a toggle for EDI acceptance and remitTo mapping instructions.

Operational asks for Marcus/Laura:
- Marcus: please confirm whether Redwood's connector can accept remitTo as free-text vs structured (we currently prefer structured: remitToId -> bankId or accountAlias). If free-text is allowed, note any reconciliation caveats. Also confirm if we support EDI 997 out-of-the-box or if we'll transform to API callbacks.
- Laura: once infra confirms, I'll create a short procurement-friendly checklist for MedTrek with acceptance criteria.

Doc/attachments: Redwood_MSA_v3_redlined.docx (redline), internal comment memo (included in docx).

Request: Julia, if these positions look acceptable we can (1) mark the MSA redline as final and prepare DocuSign, or (2) flag any remaining items for a brief call. Please confirm by Tuesday so we can keep the Coupa ticket on schedule.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachment: Redwood_MSA_v3_redlined.docx (docx)

-----Original Message-----

From: Julia Park <julia.park@medtrek.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2025-05-19T14:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Coupa activation: PO/Invoice schema + MSA checklist

Marissa / Naomi / Marcus / Laura — thanks for the quick turnaround. We reviewed the redline and the team is comfortable with the proposed positions except for two small items:

1) Audit logs: MedTrek's compliance requires 5 years for invoice transaction logs. We can accept Redwood's 3-year standard if Redwood adds an extension clause with pricing; can you add language and an indicative add-on price?
2) Invoice ack SLA: 48 hours is acceptable but we ask for an explicit 997/ACK example in the checklist (our integrator needs a sample ack chunk).

I've attached our updated PO schema which includes the remitToId column and a sample 997 ack (sheet: 997_sample). Attachment: MedTrek_PO_schema_v2.xlsx (updated).

Next steps: if you add the auditing extension language and include the example 997 in the onboarding checklist, we can proceed to DocuSign and schedule go-live. Proposed activation date: 2025-06-02.

Best,
Julia Park
Procurement Manager | MedTrek Pharma
julia.park@medtrek.com
Attachment: MedTrek_PO_schema_v2.xlsx (xlsx, updated)

----
Notes: Naomi to confirm go/no-go and set up a 30-minute sign-off call if needed.
